name: DaitaFix
author: callumdaitafix

sections.description:
DaitaFix measures how often your brand appears in AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the DaitaFix platform, enabling:

  • AI search visibility scanning and scoring
  • GEO-optimised content improvements for your pages
  • robots.txt, agents.md, and llms.txt publishing directly to your site root
  • One-click AI traffic attribution tracking
sections.installation:
1. Install via the WordPress plugin directory: search for “DaitaFix”
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Connect your site at daitafix.com
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a DaitaFix account?

Yes. The plugin connects to daitafix.com. Sign up at daitafix.com/signup to get started.

What permissions does this plugin require?

The plugin uses WordPress Application Passwords for authentication. Only users with the Administrator role can use the plugin’s API endpoints.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Confirm compatibility with WordPress 7.1

1.2.0

  • Add one-click Organisation Schema and Brand Brain structured-data install/uninstall, auto-injected on wp_head
  • Fix: rolling back robots.txt, agents.md, or llms.txt on their first-ever publish now correctly removes the file instead of failing

1.1.0

  • Add one-click AI traffic attribution pixel install/uninstall, auto-injected on wp_head

1.0.2

  • Add llms.txt to allowed file list so brand entity file can be published via DaitaFix dashboard

1.0.1

  • Use get_home_path() instead of ABSPATH for site-root files to support split home/site setups
  • Move backup files to uploads/daitafix-backups/ instead of site root
  • Fix Contributors field to use correct WordPress.org username

1.0.0

  • Initial release
